title: Practice 7: Prepositional endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Я баптист в ___ (пятый) поколении.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «поколении»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He was completely in a trance.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «трансе»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «сегменте»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
